skill.name: Chum the Waters
skill.description: Fizz tosses a fish in a direction that attaches to any champion that touches it, slowing the target. After a short delay, a shark erupts from the ground, knocking up the target and knocking any nearby enemies aside. All enemies hit are dealt magic damage and slowed.

skill.name: Killer Instinct
skill.description: Kai'Sa dashes near an enemy champion.

skill.name: Shattered Earth / Upheaval
skill.description: Skarner rips a boulder from the earth that empowers his attacks and can be thrown as a powerful projectile.

skill.name: Nevermove
skill.description: Swain launches a wave of demonic power forward. It then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits. Swain can then choose to pull all rooted champions closer. This ability has a shorter cooldown during Demonic Ascension.
